summary: Request-body fields the spec declares as integer, number, or boolean are sent as JSON numbers/booleans even when the flag is string-backed; non-numeric input fails locally.
reason: This print backs those flags with strings (ID/cursor/nullable overrides) and copied the raw string into the JSON body, so strict APIs rejected values like "page":"1" with HTTP 400/422. A regen on a current Printing Press must keep the declared JSON type for body fields.
validated_outcome: TestJSONBodyScalarsSentWithDeclaredType fails on the previous code (value arrives as a JSON string) and passes after the patch.
